findings.title: Filtered Grafana rules are rendered without a React key
findings.body: FilterViewResults maps filtered rules and, for origin 'grafana', returns GrafanaRuleListItem without the key that the previous GrafanaRuleLoader received (key={key}). Datasource rows still set key={key}. Without a stable key, React reconciles list rows by index, so scrolling, polling, or appending the next page can reuse the wrong row state (expanded menus, silence drawer, permissions) and React will warn about missing keys in a list.

findings.title: Pause stays hidden in the list view even when prom abilities allow it
findings.body: canPause is true if either ruler or Grafana Prometheus pause abilities allow the action, which is how the list view is supposed to authorize actions after ruler fetches were removed. The Pause menu item is still rendered only when rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) is true. GrafanaRuleListItem never passes a ruler rule, so Pause is never shown for Grafana-managed rules in the new list, including rules the user is allowed to pause.

findings.title: Delete is gated on a ruler rule the list view no longer has
findings.body: canDelete is OR'd with Grafana Prometheus delete abilities so the list view can authorize delete without the ruler API. The Delete item is still rendered only when rulerRule is defined, and onClick passes that ruler rule into handleDelete. List rows only have a Prometheus rule, and RuleActionsButtons already deletes via the identifier (showDeleteModal(identifier, groupIdentifier)), so users with delete permission never see Delete on Grafana rules in the new list.

findings.title: Silence menu item is a no-op without a ruler rule
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu can show Silence from Grafana Prometheus abilities and calls handleSilence, which only sets showSilenceDrawer. The drawer is rendered only when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true. The new list passes promRule and no ruler rule, so Silence appears (and is asserted in GrafanaGroupLoader tests) but clicking it never opens SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer.

findings.title: Federated rules are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities used to set isFederated from isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group), which blocked edit, delete, duplicate, and pause on federated rule groups. The refactor hardcodes isFederated to false (with a TODO) inside useAllRulerRuleAbilities, which this hook now delegates to. Federated cloud rules are therefore reported as editable and removable everywhere these abilities are used, not only in the new list.
